comparison.residual_location: The 464 mismatches outside the label mask are parent-painted 2px padding around the pixmap body, not missing or incorrect button relief. The VUE crop paints this margin #3297c7 (Header face); the GTK2 fixture inherits #78a0d5 from its surrounding window/background. The button has no paint operation in this margin; R221 classifies this context difference.

conclusion: The GTK2 button reproduces the measured VUE focus outline and the full 76x36 pixmap body outside the text mask. Its pressed top band and face transition match the reference; release restores the original capture exactly and emits one click. The 123 extra state-delta pixels are confined to GTK2 text antialiasing. The 464 whole-crop mismatches are the parent-painted 2px padding region: VUE uses #3297c7 while the GTK fixture uses #78a0d5. They are context colors outside the button paint area, not a button relief defect. No historical RGB was introduced into product source.
